info.name: EasyMall Complete API
info.description: 按文件夹顺序执行；覆盖全部 36 个业务方法/路径及幂等和权限场景。每次创建独立测试数据，订单和商品历史保留。携带 token 的请求由集合级 Pre-request Script 自动签名，签名密钥来自登录响应的 signKey。

exec: // Requests with 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' are signed with the signKey from the same login (docs/API.md).
// Requests whose name contains '未签名' are sent unsigned on purpose.
if (!signKey) throw new Error('No signKey for this token: run the matching login request first.');
